facts.statement: The genus was discovered in the Portezuelo Formation of the Neuquén Basin in Neuquén Province.
facts.quote: It was discovered in exposures of the Portezuelo Formation (Turonian-Coniacian) of the Rio Neuquén Subgroup in the Neuquén Basin, Neuquén Province.

facts.statement: Patagonykus is classified within the family Alvarezsauridae, which includes taxa such as Mononykus and Alvarezsaurus.
facts.quote: Patagonykus has been classed with the Alvarezsauridae, a family which includes such taxa as the Mongolian Mononykus and the also Argentinian Alvarezsaurus.

facts.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated in 2010 that Patagonykus was 1 meter long and weighed 3.5 kilograms.
facts.quote: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated its length at 1 m and its weight at 3.5 kg.

facts.statement: Patagonykus puertai is the only known species of the extinct genus Patagonykus, an alvarezsauroid theropod that lived about 92 million years ago during the Turonian in what is now South America.
facts.quote: Patagonykus puertai es la única especie conocida del género extinto Patagonykus (gr."garra patagónica") de dinosaurio terópodo alvarezsáurido que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 92 millones de años, en el Turoniense, en lo que es hoy Sudamérica.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of an incomplete but well-preserved skeleton lacking a skull but including many vertebrae, coracoids, a partial forelimb, pelvic girdle, and hindlimbs.
facts.quote: El holotipo consiste en un incompleto pero bien preservado esqueleto, que carece de cráneo, pero que incluye muchas vértebras, los coracoides, un miembro anterior parcial, la faja pélvica, y los miembros traseros.

facts.statement: It is estimated that Patagonykus could have reached two meters in length and weighed 47 kilograms.
facts.quote: Se estima que Patagonykus pudo haber alcanzado los dos metros en longitud y a pesar 47 kilogramos.

facts.statement: Patagonykus possessed long and strong hind legs and atrophied forelimbs that formed a single claw.
facts.quote: Poseía largas y fuertes patas posteriores y los miembros anteriores atrofiados, formando una sola garra.

facts.statement: It is believed that Patagonykus may have been covered in feathers.
facts.quote: Se cree que pudo haber estado cubierto de plumas.

facts.statement: Specifically, Patagonykus is placed as the sister genus to Bonapartenykus within the taxon Patagonykinae.
facts.quote: más concretamente, se sitúa como género hermano de Bonapartenykus en el taxón Patagonykinae.

facts.statement: The parent group of Patagonykus is Alvarezsauroidea.
Patagonykus lived from the Turonian to the Coniacian, between 93.9 and 85.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Turonian to Coniacian (93.9 to 85.7 million years ago)

facts.statement: The type species of the genus Patagonykus is Patagonykus puertai.
